description: Successful spot trades of a GDEX account on one chain, newest first (/v1/user_history, keyed by the control wallet). Page with limit (max 50) and cursor = nextCursor of the previous page.

accountRef.description: Connected account from gdex_connect. Supplies session key, wallet address, API key and session data so no secret is passed in chat

sessionPrivateKey.description: Not needed (history is keyed by the control wallet); present so accountRef can fill walletAddress
